chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
There is no divorce before marriage, and there is no emancipation before ownership.

key_terms.رَسُولُ: Messenger; the Prophet conveying divine guidance
key_terms.طَلَاقَ: divorce; the legal dissolution of a marriage bond
key_terms.عِتْقَ: emancipation; the freeing of a slave
key_terms.مِلْكٍ: ownership; legal possession giving authority over emancipation

ai.seo_question: Can divorce or emancipation take effect before marriage or ownership exists?
ai.summary: This hadith establishes that certain legal acts only take effect when their proper cause or legal basis already exists. Divorce is only valid after a marriage contract exists, and emancipation is only valid regarding one whom a person already owns.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3445 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, said:
"There is no divorce before marriage, and there is no emancipation before ownership."
